= Built-in glyph icon mode
:icons: font

Supported glyphs: icon:heart[] icon:arrow-left[].

Default size: icon:heart[].

One times: icon:heart[1x].

Two times: icon:heart[2x].

Three times: icon:heart[3x].

Four times: icon:heart[4x].

Five times: icon:heart[5x].

Large: icon:heart[lg].

Fixed width: Aicon:arrow-left[fw]B.

Named size: icon:heart[size=3x].

Title is HTML-only: icon:heart[title=Heart tooltip].

Unsupported glyph: icon:not-a-real-icon[alt=Missing].
